headline: Northern Trust Announces Redemption of Series D Preferred Stock
summary: CHICAGO, August 03, 2026--Northern Trust Corp. today announced the redemption on October 1, of all outstanding shares of its Series D Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock.
